newsitem.title: USA: LSB contracts anhydrous ammonia purchases.
newsitem.headline: LSB contracts anhydrous ammonia purchases.

text.p: LSB Industries Inc said Thursday its chemical business subsidiary signed a three year supply agreement with Koch Industries to purchase about 50 percent of its annual requirement of anhydrous ammonia.
In addition, LSB said, its chemical business has an agreement with Farmland Industries for the rest of its ammonia requirements.
Noting the market for ammonia is highly volatile, LSB said the contracts were an attempt to stabilize the cost of ammonia.
In addition, the company said it intends to contract for natural gas in the future to partially offset the price fluctuations of ammonia.
